raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = "0.10.0" %}
{% set posix = 'm2-' if win else '' %}

package:
  name: r-pdp
  version: {{ version|replace("-", "_") }}

source:
  url:
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/pdp_{{ version }}.tar.gz
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/Archive/pdp/pdp_{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 24b70d95f4a499aacc349917344339992307eb50565324badb6e717ba53af2a3

build:
  number: 0
  rpaths:
    - lib/R/lib/
    - lib/

requirements:
  build:
    - cross-r-base {{ r_base }}  # [build_platform != target_platform]
    - r-tinyplot                 # [build_platform != target_platform]
    - r-lattice                  # [build_platform != target_platform]
    - {{ compiler('c') }}              # [not win]
    - {{ stdlib("c") }}                # [not win]
    - {{ compiler('m2w64_c') }}        # [win]
    - {{ stdlib("m2w64_c") }}          # [win]
    - {{ compiler('cxx') }}            # [not win]
    - {{ compiler('m2w64_cxx') }}      # [win]
    - {{ posix }}filesystem        # [win]
    - {{ posix }}make
    - {{ posix }}sed               # [win]
    - {{ posix }}coreutils         # [win]
    - {{ posix }}zip               # [win]
    - cross-r-base {{ r_base }}    # [build_platform != target_platform]
  host:
    - r-base
    - r-lattice
    - r-tinyplot
  run:
    - r-base
    - r-lattice
    - r-tinyplot

test:
  files:
    - check_deps.R
  commands:
    - $R -e "library('pdp')"           # [not win]
    - "\"%R%\" -e \"library('pdp')\""  # [win]
    - $R -f check_deps.R               # [not win]
    - "\"%R%\" -f check_deps.R"        # [win]

about:
  home: https://bgreenwell.github.io/pdp/index.html, https://github.com/bgreenwell/pdp
  license: GPL-2.0-or-later
  summary: A general framework for constructing partial dependence (i.e.,  marginal effect) plots from various types machine learning models in R.
  license_family: GPL3
  license_file:
    - {{ environ["PREFIX"] }}/lib/R/share/licenses/GPL-2

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - conda-forge/r
    - fhoehle
